subject: Orchestrating NovaHealth renewal: split PO, term alignment, and staggered onboarding
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@novahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion orchestration for NovaHealth (split PO path)

Alex —

Thanks again for the chat yesterday. To recap, NovaHealth wants to:
- Renew core Redwood footprint for 12 months (current committed SKU).
- Add a 30% capacity uplift on inference units starting month 3.
- Split payment: partial via AWS Marketplace private offer (for existing cloud integration) and a direct PO for the remainder (for procurement timing).

Concrete asks so we can move fast:
1) Confirm the split percentages for Marketplace vs direct PO (we penciled 60/40).
2) Will your procurement team accept an AWS Private Offer with a staggered acceptance window?
3) Any mandatory PO language (tax/VAT or invoice cadence) we should include in our private-offer terms?

I’ve attached a draft term sheet and the private-offer template we typically send to AWS for marketplace listings. If that split works, we’ll prepare the DocuSign for the direct PO and submit the marketplace private-offer request the same day to avoid capacity gaps.

Next steps goal: sign both lanes in parallel and onboard the uplift in month 3.

Jordan
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: NovaHealth_PO_2028-08.pdf (draft), aws_private_offer_terms_v2.docx
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@novahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Mira Singh <mira.singh@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion orchestration for NovaHealth (split PO path)

Jordan —

Thanks for the summary and the materials. High level response:
- 60/40 split (Marketplace / Direct PO) looks fine to finance.
- Procurement prefers Marketplace acceptance for the bulk (60%) because it simplifies cloud billing, but needs the remaining 40% as a paper PO with net-45 terms.
- VAT: NovaHealth is US-headquartered, so no EU VAT concerns here — standard US tax language fine.
- We need a 30-day invoice/acceptance buffer on the marketplace side to coordinate internal approvals.

Mira and procurement are on copy — Mira, can you confirm that private-offer acceptance with a 30-day window is workable? Also looping in Daniel Cho from legal, he may request a short redline of the private-offer term on liability clauses.

I’ll aim to get the PO number by next Thursday.

—Alex
Director, Procurement
NovaHealth
From: Mira Singh <mira.singh@novahealth.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@novahealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@novahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion orchestration for NovaHealth (split PO path)

On Mon, Jul 31, 2028 at 08:27, Alex Reed <alex.reed@novahealth.com> wrote:
> Jordan —
>
> Thanks for the summary and the materials. High level response:
> - 60/40 split (Marketplace / Direct PO) looks fine to finance.
> - Procurement prefers Marketplace acceptance for the bulk (60%) because it simplifies cloud billing, but needs the remaining 40% as a paper PO with net-45 terms.
>
We can accept a 30-day acceptance window on AWS Private Offer as long as the marketplace SKU and pricing are final at submission. Can you submit the private-offer request with the SKU mapping and the capacity uplift notes?

Also adding a note: procurement will require an invoice schedule for the paper PO (we prefer a single invoice after signature).

Mira
VP, Procurement Ops
NovaHealth
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Mira Singh <mira.singh@novahealth.com>, Alex Reed <alex.reed@novahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Aug 2028 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion orchestration for NovaHealth (split PO path)

Thanks, Mira — that works. Looping in Kimberly (Legal lead on marketplace contracts) and Ben (Partner/Marketplace ops) so we can:

- Kimberly: attach redline term sheet back to this thread (see attached redline_term_sheet_20280804.xlsx). The key ask from NovaHealth legal was limiting liability carve-outs and a 30-day acceptance buffer on the private-offer.
- Ben: can you confirm the SKU mapping and whether we need any special AWS account IDs when we submit the private-offer? Also confirm target SLA and ramp schedule for the month-3 uplift so we include correct capacity reservations.

Plan:
1) We’ll send updated private-offer package to AWS with SKU mapping + 30-day acceptance.
2) We’ll prepare a direct PO DocuSign for the 40% lane (single invoice, net-45).
3) Once AWS acknowledges the private offer submission, we’ll share the Docusign envelope and ingestion plan.

Jordan

On Thu, Aug 2, 2028 at 10:15, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@novahealth.com> wrote:
> Jordan / Kimberly —
> I reviewed the redline. A few small asks around indemnity and data handling; nothing blocking. Happy to finalize quickly if you accept the two edits I’ve attached.
> —Daniel
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Reed <alex.reed@novahealth.com>, Mira Singh <mira.singh@novahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Aug 2028 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion orchestration for NovaHealth (split PO path)

Jordan / team —

Confirmed SKU mapping below (production SKUs):
- REDW-STD-1000 -> marketplace SKU: redwood-inference.std.1000
- REDW-UPLIFT-30 -> marketplace SKU: redwood-inference.uplift.30pct

AWS requires the customer account ID to be listed on the private-offer; Mira, can you send the AWS account ID you want the PO bound to? Once we have that I’ll file the private-offer request.

Capacity reservation note: to guarantee the month-3 uplift we’ll reserve a burst pool for the first 30 days post-acceptance; if they want a hard SLA we’ll need a modest additional commit (we mentioned 5% in the call).

I’m attaching the internal ops checklist and will ping when the private-offer is submitted.

Ben Carter
Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redline_term_sheet_20280804.xlsx (from Jordan), aws_private_offer_terms_v2.docx (updated)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@novahealth.com>, Mira Singh <mira.singh@novahealth.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@novahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion orchestration for NovaHealth (split PO path)

All — great progress, and thanks for the quick turn. Quick status update:
- Private-offer submitted to AWS today (submitted by Ben). We included SKU mapping and a 30-day acceptance window.
- DocuSign envelope prepared for direct PO (40% lane) — link here: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/12345-abcde
- Attached final PDF (NovaHealth_PO_2028-08.pdf) mirrors the DocuSign and lists net-45 single invoice.
- Legal redlines from Daniel were accepted with two minor edits (see redline_term_sheet_20280804.xlsx).

Next steps:
- Mira: please confirm AWS account ID so Ben can bind the private-offer (if not provided by end of day Monday we'll provision to the invoice address on file).
- Alex: once PO number is issued please drop it in this thread and we’ll finalize DocuSign routing.
- Redwood ops: we’ll reserve burst capacity and notify you of ramp timeline once both lanes are accepted.

If all good I’ll move to finalize and close the loop on procurement.

Thanks — Jordan

Attachments: NovaHealth_PO_2028-08.pdf, redline_term_sheet_20280804.xlsx
